title: Antihypertensive Evidence Recommender During Pregnancy
description: Research software implementing an evidence-to-recommendation framework for automated scientific evidence retrieval, screening, extraction, standardization, and recommendation-oriented decision support, evaluated as a proof of concept for antihypertensive therapy during pregnancy.

creators.name: Arévalo, Juan D.
creators.affiliation: Spanish Network in Maternal, Neonatal, Child and Developmental Health Research (RICORS-SAMID) (RD24/0013/0013), Universidad Complutense de Madrid, Madrid, Spain
